name: Speed-up
summary: A speed-up turns a dinking rally into a fast exchange by lifting one ball hard at an opponent. It is not a winner in itself — it is an invitation to a hands battle you think you will win. Choosing the right ball to speed up matters far more than how hard you hit it.
whenToUse: A dink has come back slightly high, at or above the level of your knee.
You can take the ball in front of you rather than reaching for it.
Your partner is at the line and ready for the reply, because it is coming fast.
The opponent you are attacking has their paddle down or is still moving.
howTo: Keep the same low stance you were dinking from — a change of posture announces it.
Take the ball early, in front, before it drops below net height.
Accelerate from the shoulder and wrist together, lifting through the ball rather than swiping down.
Aim at the shoulder of the paddle-side arm, which is the hardest place to defend.
Recover the paddle to your chest before the ball reaches them.
Expect it back — a speed-up that surprises you as well is a lost point.
commonMistakes: Speeding up a ball below net height, which has to be lifted and arrives as a gift.
Telegraphing it by standing up or taking a backswing during the dink rally.
Aiming at the open court instead of at a body, where they simply block it back with the angle.
Speeding up when your partner is not ready, so the counter goes through the middle.
Doing it too often, which teaches the other team to keep their paddles up all rally.

drills.name: Only the high ones
drills.description: Dink cross-court with a partner. You may only speed up a ball that arrives above your knee. Every time you attack a lower one, you lose the rally on purpose. It trains the read rather than the swing.

drills.name: Shoulder targets
drills.description: Your partner stands at the kitchen with their paddle up. Feed yourself dinks and speed up at their paddle-side shoulder only. Count only the ones that force a block above the net.

mistake.label: Attacked from below net height: it has to be lifted, so it arrives above their waist and comes straight back through you.
